ic_device.name: INA128, INA129
ic_device.description: Low-power, general-purpose instrumentation amplifier with a three-op-amp design and gain set by an external resistor.

pins.name: REF
pins.description: Reference input. This pin must be driven by low impedance or connected to ground.

port_dependencies.condition: Supply pin feeds the amplifier output.
Supply pin feeds the amplifier output.
Reference input; drive from low impedance or connect to ground.
For gains greater than 1, place a gain resistor between pins 1 and 8.

functional_blocks.name: INA128/INA129 instrumentation amplifier
functional_blocks.description: Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier with input protection and input buffer amplifiers; an external resistor sets gain.
